items.title: Ulta (NASDAQ:ULTA) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Beauty, cosmetics, and personal care retailer Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8.9% year on year to $3.04 billion. Its GAAP profit of $6.55 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
